chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Gates of Eldoria
chapters.description: Find a way inside the Alchemist’s stronghold.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Secret Elixir
chapters.description: Speak with Master Eldrin and prepare the potion.

actions.text: A heavy oak door reinforced with iron bands. It requires a brass key.
A heavy oak door. It stands unlocked and slightly ajar.
You open the unlocked oak door and step into the laboratory.
The door is locked tight. You need to use a brass key to unlock it.
You turn the Brass Key in the lock! The oak door unlocks and opens.
A dense thorny shrub. Something brass gleams inside!
A dense thorny shrub. You have already retrieved the Brass Key from inside.
You reach inside the thorny shrub and pull out a Brass Key!
You search the shrub again, but there is nothing else inside.
You reach inside the thorny shrub and pull out a Brass Key!
You search the shrub again, but there is nothing else inside.
A glowing cauldron bubbling with ancient alchemical ingredients.
The cauldron sparkles with remaining traces of the Elixir of Wisdom!
You drop the Glowing Crystal into the bubbling cauldron. Pure golden light flashes as you brew the Elixir of Wisdom!
You step back out into the courtyard.
Master Eldrin the Alchemist, wearing blue robes and holding an ancient staff.

node_1.speaker: Master Eldrin
node_1.text: Ah, Sir Ronald! You have managed to bypass my gate security. What brings you to my laboratory?

choices.text: I seek the legendary Elixir of Wisdom!
Just exploring your impressive alchemy setup.

node_2.speaker: Master Eldrin
node_2.text: To brew the Elixir, you must drop this Glowing Crystal into my bubbling cauldron.

choices.text: Thank you, Master Eldrin! I shall do so at once.

node_3.speaker: Master Eldrin
node_3.text: Feel free to inspect the room, but do not touch the explosive compounds!
